Microsoft.title: GitHub - nano-muse/nanoMuse: nanoMuse: an open-source personal agent for every device you own. One agent with a name and a look of its own that does things, keeps working while the app is closed, remembers you, and asks before anything you cannot undo. On Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows / macOS / Linux and in the browser; your phone's screen and your computer as its hands.

Microsoft.summary:
MobileGym , MemGUI-Bench , PhoneHarness , CopilotKit/OpenMuse , Open-AutoGLM , ClawGUI : the phone operator, the traces and the product ideas. nanoMuse is an independent community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta Platforms, Inc.; Muse is their trademark.
One agent with a name and a look of its own, in the style of Meta's Muse : it does things instead of answering questions, keeps working while the app is closed, remembers you, and stops to ask before anything you could not undo. nano means the whole set, small enough to run and deploy yourself: the phone app, the desktop app, the web console and the relay that joins them are all in this repository, under GPL-3.0-or-later.
Open an issue or send a pull request ; either one helps nanoMuse get better. 2026-10-21 ⭐ 2,000 stars on GitHub and first on GitHub Trending's Swift list ( Trendshift : third on October 20, first on October 21), twenty-six days after the first release.

Microsoft.title: Designing Azure silicon on Azure silicon: EDA workloads on Cobalt 200 | Microsoft Azure Blog
Microsoft.titleEn: Designing Azure silicon on Azure silicon: EDA workloads on Cobalt 200 | Microsoft Azure Blog
Microsoft.titleKo: Azure 실리콘에서 Azure 실리콘 설계 · Cobalt 200의 EDA 워크로드 | 마이크로소프트 애저 블로그
Microsoft.summary:
Cobalt 200 was optimized for EDA workloads through increased cache size and improved memory bandwidth per core.
The shift to cloud-based EDA on Microsoft Azure offered a new level of flexibility, scale, and reliability on compute-intensive silicon design workloads.
Executing Siemens EDA solutions on Microsoft Azure Cobalt 200 provides an efficient, scalable platform for demanding verification and signoff workloads.

summaryLinesKo: Cobalt 200은 증가된 캐시 크기와 향상된 코어당 메모리 대역폭을 통해 EDA 워크로드에 최적화됨
Microsoft Azure에서 클라우드 기반 EDA로의 전환은 컴퓨팅 집약적인 실리콘 설계 워크로드에 새로운 수준의 유연성, 확장성 및 안정성을 제공함
Microsoft Azure Cobalt 200에서 Siemens EDA 솔루션을 실행하면 까다로운 검증 및 승인 워크로드를 위한 효율적이고 확장 가능한 플랫폼이 제공됨

Microsoft.summary:
Microsoft last week reported profit and loss accounts for Q1 of its fiscal 2027 , ended September 30, and revenue in the Windows OEM and Devices division shrank 22 percent from last year to $3.55 billion.
So there is a pent-up demand that we believe will come once it stabilizes and once IT budgets get a little bit more settled and expanded."

NVIDIA.summary:
Three new open source projects extend the DSX AI Factory Platform to make Kubernetes easier to run and inference faster to scale.
NVIDIA’s contribution of OpenShell to CNCF puts security infrastructure for autonomous agents in the community’s hands to build, inspect and improve — accelerating development and hardening its safeguards.
To help meet them, NVIDIA is deepening its commitment to open source at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon , the flagship conference for the Kubernetes and cloud-native communities.

summaryLinesKo: 세 가지 새로운 오픈 소스 프로젝트는 DSX AI Factory 플랫폼을 확장하여 Kubernetes를 더 쉽게 실행하고 추론을 더 빠르게 확장할 수 있도록 함
CNCF에 대한 NVIDIA의 OpenShell 기여는 자율 에이전트를 위한 보안 인프라를 커뮤니티의 손에 맡겨 구축, 검사 및 개선함으로써 개발을 가속화하고 보호 장치를 강화함
이를 충족하기 위해 NVIDIA는 Kubernetes 및 클라우드 네이티브 커뮤니티를 위한 대표 컨퍼런스인 KubeCon + CloudNativeCon에서 오픈 소스에 대한 헌신을 심화하고 있음

NVIDIA.summary:
Arm's Jeff DeFilippi spoke with @TheNextPlatform to share why latency, concurrency, and completed tasks per rack matter when evaluating infrastructure for agentic AI workloads.
Arm technology is deployed across every major hyperscaler, and Arm-based rack-scale servers have now overtaken x86 as the dominant platform for accelerated computing, according to IDC .
Agentic infrastructure also needs independent compute that can observe, isolate and govern policies outside the environment where the agent itself is running.

Agentic infrastructure also needs independent compute that can observe, isolate and govern policies outside the environment where the agent itself is running.

IDC에 따르면 Arm 기술은 모든 주요 하이퍼스케일러에 배포되었으며 Arm 기반 랙 규모 서버는 이제 x86을 가속 컴퓨팅의 주요 플랫폼으로 추월함
또한 에이전트 인프라에는 에이전트 자체가 실행되는 환경 외부의 정책을 관찰, 격리 및 관리할 수 있는 독립적인 컴퓨팅이 필요함

NVIDIA.title: NVIDIA Dynamo Recipes Bring Korea’s Leading Open Models to Production
NVIDIA.titleEn: NVIDIA Dynamo Recipes Bring Korea’s Leading Open Models to Production
NVIDIA.titleKo: NVIDIA Dynamo 레시피로 한국 최고의 개방형 모델 생산 가능
NVIDIA.summary:
Optimized for NVIDIA B200 GPUs, these recipes take the guesswork out of deployment, delivering up to 2x performance out of the box.
They help developers bring Korea’s open models into production faster and turn them into broadly accessible AI for All services.
NVIDIA is releasing Dynamo-optimized deployment recipes for Korea’s leading open models: A.X K2 from SK Telecom , K-EXAONE 2.0 from LG AI Research , Solar Open 2 from Upstage and Motif-3 from Motif Technologies .

이는 개발자가 한국의 개방형 모델을 보다 빠르게 생산에 투입하고 이를 광범위하게 액세스 가능한 AI for All 서비스로 전환하는 데 도움이 됨

NVIDIA.title: From Chips to Skills, NVIDIA and Korea Expand Sovereign AI Collaboration
NVIDIA.titleEn: From Chips to Skills, NVIDIA and Korea Expand Sovereign AI Collaboration
NVIDIA.titleKo: 칩부터 기술까지, 엔비디아와 한국, 소버린 AI 협업 확대
NVIDIA.summary:
NVIDIA and Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) are expanding their collaboration across the country’s sovereign AI ecosystem, from AI semiconductors and data center infrastructure to talent, startups, models, agents and security.
The collaboration lays the groundwork for Korean NPU and XPU companies to explore participation in the NVIDIA NVLink Fusion ecosystem, and includes NVIDIA training and certification programs, hackathons and technical seminars to strengthen GPU utilization.
Through Korea’s AI for All initiative, NVIDIA will collaborate with three selected consortia and four leading Korean foundation model builders, using NVIDIA Dynamo software to optimize and scale AI inference.
summaryLinesEn: NVIDIA and Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) are expanding their collaboration across the country’s sovereign AI ecosystem, from AI semiconductors and data center infrastructure to talent, startups, models, agents and security.

The collaboration lays the groundwork for Korean NPU and XPU companies to explore participation in the NVIDIA NVLink Fusion ecosystem, and includes NVIDIA training and certification programs, hackathons and technical seminars to strengthen GPU utilization.

Through Korea’s AI for All initiative, NVIDIA will collaborate with three selected consortia and four leading Korean foundation model builders, using NVIDIA Dynamo software to optimize and scale AI inference.
summaryLinesKo: 엔비디아와 한국 과학기술정보통신부(MSIT)는 AI 반도체와 데이터센터 인프라부터 인재, 스타트업, 모델, 에이전트, 보안에 이르기까지 국가의 AI 생태계 전반에 걸쳐 협력을 확대하고 있음
이번 협력은 한국 NPU 및 XPU 기업이 NVIDIA NVLink Fusion 생태계에 참여할 수 있는 토대를 마련하고 GPU 활용도를 강화하기 위한 NVIDIA 교육 및 인증 프로그램, 해커톤 및 기술 세미나를 포함함
한국의 AI for All 이니셔티브를 통해 NVIDIA는 선정된 3개의 컨소시엄 및 4개의 주요 한국 기반 모델 구축업체와 협력하여 NVIDIA Dynamo 소프트웨어를 사용하여 AI 추론을 최적화하고 확장할 예정임

NVIDIA.title: Korea’s AI Ecosystem Advances and Secures Agentic AI With NVIDIA
NVIDIA.titleEn: Korea’s AI Ecosystem Advances and Secures Agentic AI With NVIDIA
NVIDIA.titleKo: 한국의 AI 생태계는 NVIDIA를 통해 Agentic AI를 발전시키고 보호함
NVIDIA.summary:
Nemotron-Personas-Korea is an open dataset of 7 million fully synthetic Korean personas, grounded in official Korean statistics, that model builders use to ground training data and evaluation in Korean contexts.
As AI agents take on more work, they need capable open models and security that advances alongside them.
On the model side, LG AI Research is opening application programming interface access for K-EXAONE-2.5, developed using NVIDIA Nemotron datasets, including Nemotron-Personas-Korea .

On the model side, LG AI Research is opening application programming interface access for K-EXAONE-2.5, developed using NVIDIA Nemotron datasets, including Nemotron-Personas-Korea .
summaryLinesKo: Nemotron-Personas-KOREA는 공식 한국 통계에 기초한 700만 개의 완전 합성 한국 페르소나로 구성된 공개 데이터세트로, 모델 작성자가 한국 상황에서 훈련 데이터와 평가를 기반으로 사용함
AI 에이전트가 더 많은 작업을 수행함에 따라 AI 에이전트와 함께 발전할 수 있는 개방형 모델과 보안이 필요함
모델 측면에서 LG AI Research는 Nemotron-Personas-KOREA를 포함한 NVIDIA Nemotron 데이터 세트를 사용하여 개발된 K-EXAONE-2.5에 대한 애플리케이션 프로그래밍 인터페이스 액세스를 공개함

NVIDIA.title: NVIDIA Announces New Planned Investments in Korean Startups at the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum
NVIDIA.titleEn: NVIDIA Announces New Planned Investments in Korean Startups at the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum
NVIDIA.titleKo: NVIDIA, 과기정통부-NVIDIA AI 스타트업 파트너십 포럼에서 한국 스타트업에 대한 새로운 투자 계획 발표
NVIDIA.summary:
NVIDIA also announced an investment in Korean startup Point2 , with additional investments planned in Motif Technologies , RLWRLD and Upstage.
The planned investments build on NVIDIA’s work with Korea’s startup and venture community, including more than 1,000 Korea-based members of NVIDIA Inception , a program that helps startups grow with access to preferred pricing, technical expertise and opportunities for investor introductions.
Point2 Technology, an AI interconnect company, builds scalable, radio frequency-based interconnects that move data between chips and racks in AI factories, offering an innovative alternative to conventional copper and optical interconnect solutions for AI cluster scale-up, delivering the reach, performance and efficiency needed for next-generation AI infrastructure.
summaryLinesEn: NVIDIA also announced an investment in Korean startup Point2 , with additional investments planned in Motif Technologies , RLWRLD and Upstage.

The planned investments build on NVIDIA’s work with Korea’s startup and venture community, including more than 1,000 Korea-based members of NVIDIA Inception , a program that helps startups grow with access to preferred pricing, technical expertise and opportunities for investor introductions.

Point2 Technology, an AI interconnect company, builds scalable, radio frequency-based interconnects that move data between chips and racks in AI factories, offering an innovative alternative to conventional copper and optical interconnect solutions for AI cluster scale-up, delivering the reach, performance and efficiency needed for next-generation AI infrastructure.
summaryLinesKo: NVIDIA는 또한 Motif Technologies, RLWRLD 및 Upstage에 대한 추가 투자 계획과 함께 한국 스타트업 Point2에 대한 투자를 발표함
계획된 투자는 스타트업이 우대 가격, 기술 전문 지식 및 투자자 소개 기회를 이용하여 성장할 수 있도록 돕는 프로그램인 NVIDIA Inception의 한국 기반 회원 1,000명 이상을 포함하여 한국 스타트업 및 벤처 커뮤니티와의 NVIDIA의 협력을 기반으로 함
AI 상호 연결 회사인 Point2 Technology는 AI 공장의 칩과 랙 간에 데이터를 이동하는 확장 가능한 무선 주파수 기반 상호 연결을 구축하여 AI 클러스터 확장을 위한 기존 구리 및 광 상호 연결 솔루션에 대한 혁신적인 대안을 제공하고 차세대 AI 인프라에 필요한 도달 범위, 성능 및 효율성을 제공함

NVIDIA.title: Practice Makes Precise: At CoRL, NVIDIA and Partners Reveal How Robots Rehearse Delicate Work in Simulation
NVIDIA.titleEn: Practice Makes Precise: At CoRL, NVIDIA and Partners Reveal How Robots Rehearse Delicate Work in Simulation
NVIDIA.titleKo: 연습이 정확함을 만듬 · CoRL에서 NVIDIA와 파트너가 로봇이 시뮬레이션에서 섬세한 작업을 연습하는 방법을 공개함
NVIDIA.summary:
Its latest release, Isaac Lab 3.0 , allows researchers to use agents to quickly set up training environments with simulation-ready assets , switch between NVIDIA PhysX and Newton physics solvers , choose renderers for perception-based training and apply a new reinforcement post-training library to foundation models like GR00T.
The shift from locomotion to manipulation is taking center stage at this week’s Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) in Austin, Texas, alongside the rise of agentic robotics — a new paradigm that integrates frontier agents to create interpretable code for physical robotics systems.
Trained on diverse robot and human data, including 100,000 hours of NVIDIA open source human egocentric data , the model enables robots to learn dexterous manipulation skills.

이동에서 조작으로의 전환은 이번 주 텍사스주 오스틴에서 열리는 로봇 학습 컨퍼런스(CoRL)에서 에이전트 로봇공학의 부상과 함께 중심 무대로 자리잡고 있음 · 에이전트 로봇공학은 물리적 로봇 시스템을 위한 해석 가능한 코드를 생성하기 위해 프론티어 에이전트를 통합하는 새로운 패러다임임
100,000시간의 NVIDIA 오픈 소스 인간 자기 중심 데이터를 포함하여 다양한 로봇 및 인간 데이터에 대해 훈련된 이 모델을 통해 로봇은 능숙한 조작 기술을 배울 수 있음

100,000시간의 NVIDIA 오픈 소스 인간 자기 중심 데이터를 포함하여 다양한 로봇 및 인간 데이터에 대해 훈련된 이 모델을 통해 로봇은 능숙한 조작 기술을 배울 수 있음

Apple.title: Apple’s $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features
Apple.titleEn: Apple’s $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features
Apple.titleKo: Apple의 50달러 Intelligence Usage Pack은 일부 AI 기능에 대한 액세스를 확장함
Apple.summary:
Users finding themselves running out of access can find the option to buy an Intelligence Usage Pack in the Intelligence Features > Show Usage section of the app’s main menu.
After publishing a support article in early September outlining usage limits for some Apple Intelligence features, the company has updated Logic Pro with an option to “Buy More Usage” for a one-time purchase price of $49.99, as spotted by 9to5Mac .
These Intelligence Usage Packs, as Apple calls them, will allow users to continue accessing certain Apple Intelligence features that have usage limits because they rely on cloud-based AI models from OpenAI or Google Gemini.

Clean Up in Photos for removing unwanted objects from images.
Developers in China can turn on ‌Apple Intelligence‌ after updating to the new software. ‌Apple Intelligence‌ first launched in the United States with iOS 18.1, but Apple was not able to bring it to China until it partnered with Alibaba and won approval from Chinese regulators. ‌Apple Intelligence‌ features like Siri , Writing Tools, and Visual Intelligence integrate Alibaba's Qwen model.
Select Apple Intelligence features are now available in China , with Apple testing the functionality in the iOS 27.3 beta.

Google DeepMind.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
Google DeepMind.titleEn: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
Google DeepMind.titleKo: Google, 두 가지 새로운 특수 칩으로 AI 하드웨어 포트폴리오 확장
Google DeepMind.summary:
Google on Monday unveiled two new variants of its tensor processing units (TPUs), in-house-developed chips meant for AI workloads, that broaden its chip portfolio to additional use cases: confidential inference and more memory capacity for large workloads.
Meanwhile, TPU 8i Max basically combines two of the inference-focused TPU 8i chips the company launched in April, doubling the memory capacity, processing power and bandwidth, but in a single package.
The new units, TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max, are part of the company’s eighth generation of chips introduced in April this year, and build on what those chips offered, which was more inference capacity and support for large training requirements.

Meanwhile, TPU 8i Max basically combines two of the inference-focused TPU 8i chips the company launched in April, doubling the memory capacity, processing power and bandwidth, but in a single package.

The new units, TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max, are part of the company’s eighth generation of chips introduced in April this year, and build on what those chips offered, which was more inference capacity and support for large training requirements.
summaryLinesKo: Google은 월요일 AI 워크로드용으로 자체 개발한 칩인 TPU(텐서 처리 장치)의 두 가지 새로운 변형을 공개함 · 이 칩은 칩 포트폴리오를 추가 사용 사례로 확장함 · 즉, 기밀 추론 및 대규모 워크로드를 위한 더 많은 메모리 용량임
한편 TPU 8i Max는 기본적으로 회사가 4월에 출시한 추론 중심 TPU 8i 칩 2개를 결합하여 메모리 용량, 처리 능력 및 대역폭을 두 배로 늘리면서도 단일 패키지로 제공함
새로운 장치인 TPU 8tx 및 TPU 8i Max는 올해 4월에 출시된 회사의 8세대 칩의 일부이며 해당 칩이 제공하는 것, 즉 더 많은 추론 용량과 대규모 교육 요구 사항에 대한 지원을 기반으로 구축됨

Google DeepMind.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature
Google DeepMind.titleEn: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature
Google DeepMind.titleKo: 구글, 에이전트 '스웜' 기능 탑재한 제미니 4 카본 출시
Google DeepMind.summary:
Google says Gemini 4 Carbon “pushes the frontier even further” than Argon, referring to the company’s other frontier model that launched only last month .
The model is launching with an introductory price of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, around a fifth the cost of OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra and a quarter the cost of Anthropic’s Fable 5.2 model, which launched yesterday .
To highlight Carbon’s utility for long-horizon work involving AI agents, Google said it is also previewing a “swarm” feature on its agentic development platform Antigravity, which will let users turn a single prompt “into a coordinated team of agents.”

이 모델은 백만 입력 토큰당 2달러, 출력 토큰 백만 달러당 10달러의 초기 가격으로 출시됨 · 이는 OpenAI의 GPT-6 Astra 비용의 약 5분의 1이고 어제 출시된 Anthropic의 Fable 5.2 모델 비용의 4분의 1임
AI 에이전트와 관련된 장거리 작업에 대한 Carbon의 유용성을 강조하기 위해 Google은 에이전트 개발 플랫폼인 Antigravity에서 사용자가 단일 프롬프트를 "조율된 에이전트 팀"으로 전환할 수 있는 "군집" 기능을 미리 선보이고 있다고 밝힘

Google DeepMind.summary:
According to the company, Google’s own model, Gemini 4 Argon, achieves a jailbreak resistance of 99.5 percent, compared to 82 percent for its predecessor, Gemini Robotics ER 2.
Google Deepmind introduced Gemini Robotics 2.5, a new VLA model it says performs 30 to 100 percent better than its own previous baselines depending on the task type.
According to Google Deepmind, Gemini Robotics 2.5 uses real-time control that enables the robot to avoid physical hazards while performing a task.

Google DeepMind.title: Formal Verification of Signal’s Protocol with Gemini
Google DeepMind.titleEn: Formal Verification of Signal’s Protocol with Gemini
Google DeepMind.titleKo: Gemini를 통한 Signal 프로토콜의 공식 검증
Google DeepMind.summary:
Our agents went further, proving that the compiled code fulfills the key security properties – such as keeping messages protected before and after a device is temporarily compromised – down to the exact code running on devices.
While prior formal verification focused on smaller portions of the code, Google DeepMind's approach enables significant expansion,” said Ehren Kret, Chief Technology Officer of Signal.
We also thank Tulsee Doshi, Four Flynn, Kate Olszewska, Alicia Huang, Andy Liu, Benoit Schillings, Raluca Ada Popa, Melvin Johnson, Koray Kavukcuoglu, Demis Hassabis, and Sundar Pichai for their support of the project.
summaryLinesEn: Our agents went further, proving that the compiled code fulfills the key security properties – such as keeping messages protected before and after a device is temporarily compromised – down to the exact code running on devices.

Google DeepMind.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5: Accelerating Physical Intelligence
Google DeepMind.summary:
Using our embodied reasoning model ( Gemini Robotics ER ) to keep track of the workflow, and the Gemini Robotics 2.5 actions model to control its hands and arms, the robot reaches into supply bins, picks up metal automotive brackets, and places them into sequencing containers, all while correcting for any gaps.
Examples of Gemini 4 Argon’s robotics research capabilities accelerating Gemini Robotics 2.5 Argon can generate thousands of varied, simulated practice runs from a real-world camera scene and build a realistic digital twin.
To help ensure this, we have significantly advanced Gemini Robotics 2.5’s safety features.

Anthropic.titleEn: Anthropic joins AI’s natural gas frenzy, buys $3.4B worth of turbines
Anthropic.titleKo: Anthropic은 AI의 천연가스 열풍에 동참하고 34억 달러 상당의 터빈을 구매함
Anthropic.summary:
AI’s power crunch has become so acute that Anthropic, a company that has generally avoided buying physical infrastructure, is spending $3.4 billion on natural gas turbines.
The company disclosed in its S-1 filing in May that it is paying SpaceX subsidiary xAI $1.25 billion per month through May 2029 to use xAI’s computing power.
The generators are capable of producing up to 1.7 gigawatts of electricity.

Anthropic.title: Claude can design electronic prototypes from start to finish
Anthropic.titleEn: Claude can design electronic prototypes from start to finish
Anthropic.titleKo: Claude는 전자 프로토타입을 처음부터 끝까지 디자인할 수 있음
Anthropic.summary:
You have to not only design and simulate a circuit board, but also reason about the board’s physical layout and how it will behave, model the mechanical components, and write firmware—all while keeping track of which parts are readily available and what a factory is set up to build.
Because the devices are early prototypes, we don’t yet know how they’ll hold up with continued use or whether they would pass commercial certifications.
To see how newer Claude models have improved in this area, we collaborated with Diode again, this time asking Claude Fable 5.2 to design three electronic devices: a speakerphone, a voice-assistant hub, and a handheld virtual pet.

Because the devices are early prototypes, we don’t yet know how they’ll hold up with continued use or whether they would pass commercial certifications.

To see how newer Claude models have improved in this area, we collaborated with Diode again, this time asking Claude Fable 5.2 to design three electronic devices: a speakerphone, a voice-assistant hub, and a handheld virtual pet.
summaryLinesKo: 회로 기판을 설계하고 시뮬레이션할 뿐만 아니라 기판의 물리적 레이아웃과 작동 방식을 추론하고, 기계 구성 요소를 모델링하고, 펌웨어를 작성하는 동시에 어떤 부품을 쉽게 사용할 수 있는지, 어떤 공장이 구축되어 있는지 추적해야 함
이 장치는 초기 프로토타입이기 때문에 계속 사용할 수 있을지, 상용 인증을 통과할지 여부는 아직 알 수 없음
이 분야에서 최신 Claude 모델이 어떻게 개선되었는지 확인하기 위해 우리는 Diode와 다시 협력하여 이번에는 Claude Fable 5.2에게 스피커폰, 음성 지원 허브, 휴대용 가상 애완동물 등 세 가지 전자 장치를 설계하도록 요청함

Anthropic.title: Andrej Karpathy built a curated video platform in a weekend using Claude and 20 years of Hacker News
Anthropic.titleEn: Andrej Karpathy built a curated video platform in a weekend using Claude and 20 years of Hacker News
Anthropic.titleKo: Andrej Karpathy는 Claude와 20년간의 Hacker News를 사용하여 주말에 선별된 비디오 플랫폼을 구축함
Anthropic.summary:
Claude filtered 43 million comments from 20 years of Hacker News and distilled them into 6,454 videos that keep getting recommended there .
The site needs no login, shows a single mid-video frame instead of optimized thumbnails, and stores state locally in the browser.
Andrej Karpathy, OpenAI co-founder and current Anthropic AI researcher, built HackerTube over a weekend using Claude's Opus 5.5 model.

Databricks.title: Turn buying signals into pipeline with Sendoso gifts in Genie One | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: Turn buying signals into pipeline with Sendoso gifts in Genie One | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: Genie One의 Sendoso 선물로 구매 신호를 파이프라인으로 전환 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
Gift history lives in the same workspace as pipeline data, so teams can report on the deals each gift influenced and manage gifting like any other investment.
Gifting is worth the effort because other channels are crowded: Sendoso's 2026 Digital Fatigue Report found 84% of buyers are fatigued by cold calls and 83% by marketing emails.
Sendoso's MCP server brings gifting and direct mail into Genie One, so business teams can turn an intent signal from their own data into a previewed, approved gift in one conversation.

summaryLinesKo: 선물 내역은 파이프라인 데이터와 동일한 작업 공간에 있으므로 팀은 각 선물이 영향을 준 거래에 대해 보고하고 다른 투자와 마찬가지로 선물을 관리할 수 있음
다른 채널이 붐비기 때문에 선물을 주는 것은 노력할 가치가 있음 · Sendoso의 2026년 디지털 피로 보고서에 따르면 구매자의 84%는 콜드 콜로, 83%는 마케팅 이메일로 피로를 느끼는 것으로 나타남
Sendoso의 MCP 서버는 Genie One에 선물 및 다이렉트 메일을 제공하므로 비즈니스 팀은 한 번의 대화를 통해 자체 데이터의 의도 신호를 미리 보고 승인된 선물로 전환할 수 있음

Databricks.title: Accelerate GPU training on Unity Catalog tables with UCDataset | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: Accelerate GPU training on Unity Catalog tables with UCDataset | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: UCDataset를 사용하여 Unity Catalog 테이블에서 GPU 교육 가속화 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
Getting it into a distributed training job means picking one of three workarounds, and each one costs you time and money:
UCDataset is a native PyTorch data loader that streams Unity Catalog tables directly to every GPU in your training job, with no exports, no copies, and no custom loader code.
Most training data for your models already lives in Unity Catalog tables.

Most training data for your models already lives in Unity Catalog tables.
summaryLinesKo: 분산 교육 작업을 수행하려면 세 가지 해결 방법 중 하나를 선택해야 하며 각 해결 방법에는 시간과 비용이 소요됨
UCDataset는 내보내기, 복사본, 커스텀 로더 코드 없이 Unity Catalog 테이블을 학습 작업의 모든 GPU에 직접 스트리밍하는 기본 PyTorch 데이터 로더임
모델에 대한 대부분의 훈련 데이터는 이미 Unity 카탈로그 테이블에 있음

Databricks.title: Databricks' Commitment to European Sovereignty | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: Databricks' Commitment to European Sovereignty | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: 유럽 주권에 대한 Databricks의 헌신 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
Databricks is classified as a regional service on Azure and has been Azure EU Data Boundary compliant since EUDB launched.
That investment has always been driven by a specific philosophy: customers should control where their data lives, how it's protected, and who can access it.
In addition, European customers can now contract directly with a Databricks European Union (EU) entity, making procurement simpler for customers that require a European counterparty.

summaryLinesKo: Databricks는 Azure에서 지역 서비스로 분류되며 EUDB 출시 이후 Azure EU 데이터 경계를 준수해 왔음
이러한 투자는 항상 특정 철학에 의해 주도됨 · 즉, 고객은 자신의 데이터가 보관되는 위치, 보호 방법, 액세스할 수 있는 사람을 제어해야 함

Databricks.titleKo: 사기 분석가 AI 동료 · Databricks의 실시간 통신 사기 탐지 | 데이터브릭스
Databricks.summary:
In this demo, Razi Bayati, a Delivery Solutions Architect at Databricks, shows how a fraud analyst AI coworker detects telecom fraud in real time on one platform with Lakeflow, Lakebase, Unity Catalog, Genie, and Databricks Apps, from raw network data to a case-management workbench for analysts, managers and executives.
Fraud now moves at machine speed, but most detection still runs on overnight batch jobs.
Discover Lakebase, the fully managed OLTP database from Databricks built for data apps and AI agents.

Databricks.summary:
Read the customer's table in place instead of copying it: With OpenSharing, you can follow changes on the tables your customers share through streaming or change data feed, without tracking what's been processed yourself.
Can I get new data as soon as my customer writes it, instead of waiting for the next file drop?
Sharing gets easier for your customers: Adding you as a recipient is just a grant on a table they already maintain, and audit logs record every time you access their shared data.

Databricks.title: Introducing Apache Spark® 4.3 - Now available in Databricks Runtime 19 | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: Introducing Apache Spark® 4.3 - Now available in Databricks Runtime 19 | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: Apache Spark® 4.3 소개 - 이제 Databricks Runtime 19에서 사용 가능 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
Iterate faster and build with richer APIs: Project Feather reduces execution overhead for eligible small-data queries, while improvements to Spark Connect, Python, and SQL make data and AI applications easier to develop, debug, and operate.
Streaming aggregations, deduplication, and custom stateful processing can now run in Structured Streaming's low-latency execution mode, extending it to applications that need to remember context across events.
Apache Spark 4.3 brings stateful processing to Real-Time Mode, achieving sub-150 ms P99 end-to-end latency across three representative stateful benchmarks.
summaryLinesEn: Iterate faster and build with richer APIs: Project Feather reduces execution overhead for eligible small-data queries, while improvements to Spark Connect, Python, and SQL make data and AI applications easier to develop, debug, and operate.

Streaming aggregations, deduplication, and custom stateful processing can now run in Structured Streaming's low-latency execution mode, extending it to applications that need to remember context across events.
Apache Spark 4.3 brings stateful processing to Real-Time Mode, achieving sub-150 ms P99 end-to-end latency across three representative stateful benchmarks.
summaryLinesKo: 더 빠르게 반복하고 더 풍부한 API로 구축 · Project Feather는 적격한 소규모 데이터 쿼리에 대한 실행 오버헤드를 줄이는 동시에 Spark Connect, Python 및 SQL의 개선으로 데이터 및 AI 애플리케이션을 더 쉽게 개발, 디버그 및 운영할 수 있음
이제 스트리밍 집계, 중복 제거 및 사용자 지정 상태 저장 처리를 구조적 스트리밍의 짧은 대기 시간 실행 모드에서 실행하여 이벤트 전반에 걸쳐 컨텍스트를 기억해야 하는 애플리케이션으로 확장할 수 있음
Apache Spark 4.3은 실시간 모드에 상태 저장 처리를 제공하여 세 가지 대표적인 상태 저장 벤치마크에서 150ms 미만의 P99 종단 간 대기 시간을 달성함

Mistral AI.titleEn: Mistral Says Its AI Model ‘Le Chonk’ Has Leapfrogged China in the Open-Weight Race
Mistral AI.titleKo: Mistral은 자사의 AI 모델 'Le Chonk'가 오픈 웨이트 경주에서 중국을 앞질렀다고 밝힘
Mistral AI.summary:
If AI is destined to become a central feature of both cyber offense and defense, the argument goes, businesses and governments will need to be equipped with models that are freely available and cannot be switched off remotely, unlike proprietary models from the likes of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.
At the time, the company said it was the most advanced open-weight offering outside of China.
After further refinement, Mistral now says Le Chonk is the “world’s best” open-weight model for automated coding and cybersecurity.

Mistral AI.titleKo: Mistral은 회사의 'Le Chonk' AI 모델에 대한 주권적 제어를 제공하는 Mistral Large 4에 대한 공개 가중치를 출시함 · - SiliconANGLE
Mistral AI.summary:
“Other labs have raised hundreds of billions to develop equivalent capabilities; in three years, Mistral raised roughly $6 billion.”
Open weights mean companies can take the model and deploy it on their own hardware, within their own firewalls, and run sensitive data without exposing it to the cloud or outside parties.
“Open source is essential to ensure state-of-the-art AI does not end up concentrated in the hands of a few actors,” said co-founder and Chief Executive Arthur Mensch.

Sierra AI.title: Redesigning Agent Studio around Ghostwriter
Sierra AI.summary:
Agent Studio now brings related agents into a single project, along with the data and channels they share, so your team can test and release them together.

Scale AI.titleEn: Cities Worldwide Build and Scale AI Services With NVIDIA Physical and Agentic AI
Scale AI.titleKo: 전 세계 도시에서는 NVIDIA Physical 및 Agentic AI를 사용하여 AI 서비스를 구축하고 확장함
Scale AI.summary:
Cities can extend AI to more services by building on infrastructure already in place and adding capacity.
In Wrocław, Poland , K2K is building shared AI infrastructure using NVIDIA accelerated computing, NVIDIA Cosmos world reasoning models, and NVIDIA Metropolis Blueprint for video search and summarization (VSS) to transform existing camera streams into actionable intelligence for mobility, safety and event response — using the same infrastructure across several city functions.
City teams don’t need a massive infrastructure investment to get started building these AI services: depending on the workload, NVIDIA RTX workstations or a small GPU system may be enough.

City teams don’t need a massive infrastructure investment to get started building these AI services: depending on the workload, NVIDIA RTX workstations or a small GPU system may be enough.
summaryLinesKo: 도시는 이미 존재하는 인프라를 구축하고 용량을 추가하여 AI를 더 많은 서비스로 확장할 수 있음

폴란드 브로츠와프에서 K2K는 NVIDIA 가속 컴퓨팅, NVIDIA Cosmos 세계 추론 모델, 비디오 검색 및 요약(VSS)을 위한 NVIDIA Metropolis Blueprint를 사용하여 공유 AI 인프라를 구축하고 있으며, 이를 통해 여러 도시 기능에서 동일한 인프라를 사용하여 기존 카메라 스트림을 이동성, 안전 및 이벤트 대응을 위한 실행 가능한 인텔리전스로 변환하고 있음
도시 팀은 이러한 AI 서비스 구축을 시작하기 위해 막대한 인프라 투자가 필요하지 않음 · 워크로드에 따라 NVIDIA RTX 워크스테이션 또는 소형 GPU 시스템이면 충분할 수 있음

ElevenLabs.titleEn: How ElevenLabs' CTO is rolling out AI agents—and why he thinks bigger efficiency gains are ahead for the voice AI startup | Fortune
ElevenLabs.titleKo: ElevenLabs의 CTO가 AI 에이전트를 출시하는 방법과 음성 AI 스타트업이 더 큰 효율성 향상을 이룰 것이라고 생각하는 이유 | 행운
ElevenLabs.summary:
The AI voice startup has deployed an inbound sales development representative (SDR) agent that has handled over 3,000 customer leads this year, qualifying over 90% of those potential clients in 32 different languages without any human intervention.
Marvell says the deal will allow the combined company to address a market worth $550 billion, with Chairman and CEO Matt Murphy saying, “AI infrastructure is undergoing a fundamental architectural shift toward optical connectivity, creating an opportunity that comes along once in a generation.”
He says that the efficiency gains ElevenLabs reaps from agentic AI may feel cutting edge today, but “in six months time, you can see even more gains.”

Marvell은 이번 거래를 통해 합병된 회사가 5,500억 달러 규모의 시장에 진출할 수 있게 될 것이라고 말했으며, Matt Murphy 회장 겸 CEO는 "AI 인프라는 광 연결을 향한 근본적인 아키텍처 변화를 겪고 있으며 한 세대에 한 번씩 찾아오는 기회를 창출하고 있습니다"라고 말함
그는 에이전트 AI를 통해 ElevenLabs가 얻는 효율성이 오늘날 최첨단이라고 느낄 수 있지만 "6개월 후에는 훨씬 더 많은 이점을 얻을 수 있습니다"라고 말함

Lovable.title: How we moved our frontend off Firestore and built Lovable Realtime | Lovable
Lovable.titleEn: How we moved our frontend off Firestore and built Lovable Realtime | Lovable
Lovable.titleKo: 프런트엔드를 Firestore에서 이전하고 Lovable Realtime을 구축한 방법 | 사랑스럽
Lovable.summary:
The service handles peaks of over 2 million concurrent subscriptions and delivers around 2.6 billion data and patch frames per month.
We needed the backend to decide what each user received and keep that decision up to date as both the data and their permissions changed.
When a NATS message arrives, the pod dispatches it to every matching subscription instance, which re-evaluates its data projection, deduplicates via xxh3-128 hash, and pushes the deltas to the frontend if the output changed.

Lovable.titleKo: Lovable을 구축한 방법과 이를 계속 재구축하는 이유 | 사랑스럽
Lovable.summary:
More than 100,000 pull requests in our codebase later, my co-founder Fabian and our team of engineers, designers, and product managers have turned that plan into Lovable, and our users have created more than 70 million projects on the platform to date.
Improvements to that common setup could help across many projects.
Later that year I wrote down the plan for Lovable : people who couldn’t code would create, deploy, and improve software through chat and instantly see the result.

Suno.title: Suno AI music generator sued again for copyright infringement - Engadget
Suno.titleEn: Suno AI music generator sued again for copyright infringement - Engadget
Suno.titleKo: Suno AI 음악 생성기, 저작권 침해로 다시 고소 - Engadget
Suno.summary:
It recently filed a lawsuit against Anthropic , claiming $41 million in damages for allegedly training its AI models on the musician's works without permission.
New lawsuits are claiming that Suno has once again committed copyright infringement by using Elvis Presley and Eminem's likeness to create AI-generated songs.
As first reported by Variety , a group that owns the rights to Presley's music and Eight Mile Style, a music publishing company that owns hundreds of Eminem recordings, filed separate lawsuits against Suno.
summaryLinesEn: It recently filed a lawsuit against Anthropic , claiming $41 million in damages for allegedly training its AI models on the musician's works without permission.
New lawsuits are claiming that Suno has once again committed copyright infringement by using Elvis Presley and Eminem's likeness to create AI-generated songs.

As first reported by Variety , a group that owns the rights to Presley's music and Eight Mile Style, a music publishing company that owns hundreds of Eminem recordings, filed separate lawsuits against Suno.
summaryLinesKo: 최근 Anthropic을 상대로 허가 없이 AI 모델을 음악가의 작품에 훈련시킨 혐의로 4,100만 달러의 손해 배상을 청구하는 소송을 제기함
새로운 소송에서는 Suno가 Elvis Presley와 Eminem의 유사성을 사용하여 AI 생성 노래를 만들어 다시 한 번 저작권 침해를 저질렀다고 주장하고 있음
프레슬리의 음악에 대한 권리를 소유한 그룹인 버라이어티(Variety)와 수백 개의 에미넴 음반을 소유한 음악 출판사인 에잇 마일 스타일(Eight Mile Style)이 Suno를 상대로 별도의 소송을 제기했다고 처음 보도한 바와 같음

Suno.titleEn: Use MIDI as a starting point to music creation on Suno | Suno
Suno.titleKo: Suno에서 MIDI를 음악 제작의 출발점으로 사용 | 스노
Suno.summary:
It can contain up to 16 channels of pitch and timing data, each with up to 120 controller lanes for things like modulation, volume and sustain.
MIDI is the newest of these starting points, and it works differently from the other uploadable assets because a MIDI file contains no sound at all.
But first, let’s begin with explaining what MIDI is, and why it offers such a good starting point to the creation process.

MIDI는 이러한 시작점 중 최신이며 MIDI 파일에는 사운드가 전혀 포함되어 있지 않기 때문에 업로드 가능한 다른 자산과 다르게 작동함

You can now link your Hugging Face organization to your Google Cloud account, so that your Hugging Face usage shows up on your Google Cloud bill instead of being charged to a credit card.
By linking your organization through the Google Cloud Marketplace: One bill : your Hugging Face usage appears on your existing Google Cloud invoice, next to the rest of your cloud spend.
All members of your organization can use Hugging Face compute services, and the usage will show up on your Google Cloud bill.

Hugging Face.summary:
It holds 9M personas, 50% more than Nemotron-Personas-Japan, across 50 fields instead of 22.
Open Data Breaking Down Privacy Barriers to Pave the Way for AI in Finance A compound AI approach to Japanese personas grounded in real-world distributions In the financial sector, the utilization of real-world data faces significant constraints due to strict privacy regulations, compliance requirements, and the need for advanced domain expertise.
In this context, the development of agentic AI in the financial domain requires synthetic data capable of avoiding the risks of using real data while reflecting demographics, household structures, and asset statuses to reproduce diverse, realistic financial scenarios.

Hugging Face.title: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
Hugging Face.titleEn: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
Hugging Face.titleKo: ToyBlocks: 로봇 학습 및 평가를 위한 통제된 세계
Hugging Face.summary:
ToyBlocks scales data generation through generating and executing hundreds of such plans in parallel on a single graphics processing unit (GPU), reaching up to 24 times real-time performance.
During the episode, the agent muses, “I need to figure out whether pick-and-place naturally straightens orientation or if I need to correct it manually… I have 63 calls left, plenty to run a controlled test” (0:06).
Building on our earlier work in open robot learning, including MolmoAct 2 , MolmoBot , and MolmoSpaces , ToyBlocks gives researchers a way to study robotics questions in a deliberately constrained domain.

During the episode, the agent muses, “I need to figure out whether pick-and-place naturally straightens orientation or if I need to correct it manually… I have 63 calls left, plenty to run a controlled test” (0:06).

Building on our earlier work in open robot learning, including MolmoAct 2 , MolmoBot , and MolmoSpaces , ToyBlocks gives researchers a way to study robotics questions in a deliberately constrained domain.
summaryLinesKo: ToyBlocks는 단일 그래픽 처리 장치(GPU)에서 수백 개의 이러한 계획을 병렬로 생성 및 실행하여 데이터 생성을 확장하여 실시간 성능을 최대 24배까지 향상시킴
에피소드 중에 에이전트는 "선택 및 배치가 자연스럽게 방향을 곧게 펴는지, 아니면 수동으로 수정해야 하는지 파악해야 함 · 통화가 63개 남았으니 통제된 테스트를 실행하기에 충분합니다."(0:06)라고 생각함
MolmoAct 2, MolmoBot 및 MolmoSpaces를 포함한 개방형 로봇 학습에 대한 이전 작업을 기반으로 ToyBlocks는 연구자에게 의도적으로 제한된 영역에서 로봇 공학 질문을 연구할 수 있는 방법을 제공함

Hugging Face.summary:
How Phonon did on the Hugging Face Open TTS Leaderboard Two weeks ago, we opened up Phonon, our small text-to-speech model that runs on your own device.
It needs no server and no network, and what you type stays with you.
On intelligibility, Phonon ranks first in German and Spanish , and in the top three in every language we evaluated, next to models up to 100 times its size.

Abridge.titleKo: Maine Health 임상의가 진료에 Abridge Assistant를 사용하는 방법
Abridge.summary:
Built by clinicians and machine learning scientists working side by side, it's trained to weigh what matters the way a clinician would: the allergy that rules out a drug, the family history that moves a screening up, the guideline exception this patient meets.
Jessica Faraci, a family medicine physician at Maine Health and an early adopter of the Abridge Assistant’s context-aware clinical intelligence for decision support.
Because I'm doing something different in almost every room, it's been hard to find technology flexible enough to keep up, even though I'm an EHR super user myself.

Proctor values about the “telephoto lens” is how Abridge selects the right information and orders it appropriately: Catch up: A short summary of the patient's recent care, tailored to specialty.

Writer.title: Key findings from our 2025 enterprise AI adoption report
Writer.titleEn: Key findings from our 2025 enterprise AI adoption report
Writer.titleKo: 2025년 엔터프라이즈 AI 채택 보고서의 주요 결과
Writer.summary:
For our 2025 report, Generative AI adoption in the enterprise, we surveyed a diverse group of 1,600 knowledge workers actively using AI in the workplace — including 800 C-suite executives and 800 employees across the US.
Despite clear benefits, enterprise leaders report division and power struggles from AI adoption While executives are highly optimistic about the future business impact of AI, 42% say the process of adopting generative AI is tearing their company apart.
Enterprises without a formal AI strategy report only 37% success in AI adoption, compared to 80% for those with a strategy.
summaryLinesEn: For our 2025 report, Generative AI adoption in the enterprise, we surveyed a diverse group of 1,600 knowledge workers actively using AI in the workplace — including 800 C-suite executives and 800 employees across the US.

Despite clear benefits, enterprise leaders report division and power struggles from AI adoption While executives are highly optimistic about the future business impact of AI, 42% say the process of adopting generative AI is tearing their company apart.
Enterprises without a formal AI strategy report only 37% success in AI adoption, compared to 80% for those with a strategy.
summaryLinesKo: 2025년 보고서인 기업의 생성적 AI 도입을 위해 우리는 미국 전역의 최고 경영진 800명과 직원 800명을 포함하여 직장에서 AI를 적극적으로 사용하는 1,600명의 지식 근로자로 구성된 다양한 그룹을 대상으로 설문조사를 실시함
분명한 이점에도 불구하고 기업 리더들은 AI 도입으로 인한 분열과 권력 투쟁을 보고함 · 경영진은 AI가 미래 비즈니스에 미칠 영향에 대해 매우 낙관적인 반면, 42%는 생성 AI 도입 과정이 회사를 분열시키고 있다고 말함
공식적인 AI 전략이 없는 기업은 AI 도입 성공률이 37%에 불과한 반면 전략이 있는 기업은 80%에 불과함

Writer.title: From chaos to control: why enterprises need a new framework for trusted LLMs
Writer.titleEn: From chaos to control: why enterprises need a new framework for trusted LLMs
Writer.titleKo: 혼돈에서 통제까지 · 기업에 신뢰할 수 있는 LLM을 위한 새로운 프레임워크가 필요한 이유
Writer.summary:
Today, 75% of knowledge workers use GenAI at work, but only about a third of organizations have formal AI governance in place For CIOs, this creates a familiar and uncomfortable reality: AI enthusiasm is accelerating faster than enterprise readiness.
Our newly introduced agent supervision suite delivers the governance foundation the report calls for — providing centralized visibility into usage and cost, global guardrails for sensitive data, runtime permissions and approvals, and deep integrations with your existing observability and security platforms.
And they need a model where IT can maintain oversight even as business teams accelerate adoption.

Writer.title: Five Rules for Using AI Without Creating Work Slop
Writer.titleEn: Five Rules for Using AI Without Creating Work Slop
Writer.titleKo: 업무 슬롭을 만들지 않고 AI를 사용하기 위한 5가지 규칙
Writer.summary:
With AI tools, I — a person who can’t draw a stick figure — can whip up illustrations, videos, slide decks, and some theme music to go with them at the push of a button.
Use of the AI in the workplace is growing rapidly , but simply making loads more content won’t help your team increase productivity or make an impact if it’s all kind of … blah.
They let you refine your instructions iteratively, add variables for repeatability, easily share improvements with colleagues, and build something that gets better every time you use it.

DeepSeek.summary:
From the perspective of Leikeji (ID: leitech), the 1.055 trillion yuan investment raised by DeepSeek is not only used to purchase computing power and expand model parameters, but also a layout for the future of AI, forming a grand strategy to realize the end-to-end implementation of AI software and hardware.
Recently, foreign media outlet The Information broke a major scoop in China's AI industry: DeepSeek's latest financing round has been expanded to 1.055 trillion RMB, pushing its valuation directly to 6.155 trillion RMB.
Cooperating with vivo and Midea: Seize terminal entrances and increase investment in AI hardware No matter how well the large model performs on the cloud, it ultimately needs to be implemented on terminal devices that ordinary users and families are willing to pay for.

Meta AI.title: Meta is expanding AI age detection for Instagram teen accounts - Engadget
Meta AI.titleEn: Meta is expanding AI age detection for Instagram teen accounts - Engadget
Meta AI.titleKo: Meta, 인스타그램 청소년 계정에 대한 AI 연령 감지 확장 - Engadget
Meta AI.summary:
Update, November 9, 2026, 2:12PM ET: A previous version of this story indicated that Meta is using bone structure analysis of photos, as well as mentions of things like school grades or birthday celebrations to estimate a person's age.
If the systems determine the person is aged between 13 and 17, they'll be funneled into a teen account, even if they used an adult date of birth while signing up.
In August, the company reached an agreement (under which it may have to pay as much as $18 billion) with 52 attorneys general to settle a lawsuit that alleged harms to young users of its apps.

summaryLinesKo: 업데이트, 2026년 11월 9일 오후 2시 12분(ET): 이 이야기의 이전 버전에서는 Meta가 사진의 뼈 구조 분석을 사용하고 학교 성적이나 생일 축하와 같은 언급을 사용하여 사람의 나이를 추정하고 있음을 나타냄
시스템에서 해당 사용자가 13세에서 17세 사이라고 판단하면 가입 시 성인 생년월일을 사용했더라도 해당 사용자는 청소년 계정으로 분류됨

Meta AI.summary:
Muse Ember leads in most of Meta's own tests, but Haiku outperforms it on real coding tasks in FrontierCode 2.0-AA, scoring 34.9 percent to Muse Ember's 27.2 percent.
Meta has introduced Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient AI model to date.
It's available now through the Meta Model API and Muse Code at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens.

Meta AI.title: Meta expands Instagram's AI age-guessing tech globally
Meta AI.titleEn: Meta expands Instagram's AI age-guessing tech globally
Meta AI.titleKo: Meta, Instagram의 AI 연령 추측 기술을 전 세계적으로 확장
Meta AI.summary:
The global expansion comes as Meta reached settlements worth up to $18 billion with nearly every U.S. state and territory in August to resolve lawsuits alleging its platforms harm teens.
Meta announced on Monday that it’s expanding its AI-powered age-estimation technology on Instagram worldwide to identify more teens and place them under its Teen Account protections, as it faces numerous lawsuits accusing its platforms of harming teens.
Meta said parents in the U.S. will start seeing an in-feed video on Instagram explaining its approach to ensuring their teens are in age-appropriate protections.

summaryLinesKo: 이러한 글로벌 확장은 Meta가 플랫폼이 청소년에게 해를 끼친다고 주장하는 소송을 해결하기 위해 지난 8월 미국의 거의 모든 주 및 준주와 최대 180억 달러 규모의 합의에 도달함에 따라 이루어졌음
메타(Meta)는 플랫폼이 십대들에게 해를 끼친다고 비난하는 수많은 소송에 직면함에 따라 더 많은 십대들을 식별하고 그들을 십대 계정 보호 하에 두기 위해 전 세계 인스타그램에서 AI 기반 연령 추정 기술을 확장한다고 월요일 발표함
Meta는 미국의 부모들이 10대 자녀가 연령에 적합한 보호를 받을 수 있도록 하는 접근 방식을 설명하는 Instagram의 인피드 비디오를 보게 될 것이라고 말함

Once the process is complete, WhatsApp shows the expanded photo in the drawing editor, and users can choose to send it.

According to WABetaInfo , the platform is rolling out a Meta AI-powered image expansion tool, though it is currently limited to select users, primarily those in WhatsApp’s beta program via TestFlight.

Here are the details. iPhone users with access to Apple Intelligence have a native AI-powered photo expansion tool called Extend , which lets users pinch or drag to expand an image beyond its original borders.

Meta AI.title: On Facebook and Instagram, Political Ads Are Increasingly Critical of Data Centers
Meta AI.titleEn: On Facebook and Instagram, Political Ads Are Increasingly Critical of Data Centers
Meta AI.titleKo: Facebook과 Instagram에서 정치 광고는 데이터 센터에 점점 더 중요해지고 있음
Meta AI.summary:
Over a period of 90 days from Jul. 27 to Oct. 24, advertisers on Facebook and Instagram spent almost $12 million on ads that mention data centers in the context of social issues, elections or politics .
The remaining 39% of recent spending has been for ads that support specific candidates.
Since late July, advertisers spent more than $1 million on political ads mentioning data centers that targeted Facebook and Instagram users in each of three states – Ohio, Wisconsin and Texas.

summaryLinesKo: 7월 27일부터 10월 24일까지 90일 동안 Facebook과 Instagram의 광고주들은 사회 문제, 선거 또는 정치와 관련된 데이터 센터를 언급하는 광고에 거의 1,200만 달러를 지출함
최근 지출의 나머지 39%는 특정 후보자를 지지하는 광고에 사용됨
